'''Rendor's Raiders''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that [[Skirmish in the Kwymar sector|fought]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]. Each member was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and two [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. A [[Specialist/Legends|specialist]] was armed with a tripod-mounted [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].
